summary: Iteration 188 Comprehensive Testing - FULL PASS (33/33 tests). 2FA/TOTP lifecycle verified (setup, verify, login challenge, recovery codes, regenerate, disable). DSGVO export with richer _iter188 structure verified. read_db extension on admin/stats, search/global, admin/health verified. All regression tests pass.

2FA LOGIN FLOW CORRECT: Login with 2FA enabled returns totp_required=true + challenge_token (5-min expiry)
RECOVERY CODES WORKING: 10 codes generated, bcrypt-hashed, single-use consumption verified
EXPIRED CHALLENGE TOKEN: Returns 401 as expected
NO SECRET LEAKS: user_response() in dependencies.py strips totp_secret, totp_pending_secret, totp_recovery_hashes, totp_pending_recovery_hashes
DSGVO EXPORT ENHANCED: /users/me/export returns legacy keys + new _iter188 nested structure
DSGVO PRIVACY: profile excludes password_hash and totp_secret, caldav_config masks password with ***hidden***
READ_DB EXTENSION: admin/stats, search/global, services/health_metrics.py use read_db for SECONDARY_PREFERRED reads
REGRESSION PASS: News feed, surveys, meetings, chat routes, privacy guards all working
seed_data_creation: Test users created with TEST_ prefix during 2FA testing, cleaned up after each test
context_for_next_testing_agent: Iteration 188 validated 2FA/TOTP implementation, DSGVO export enhancement, and read_db extension. Key changes: (1) services/totp.py provides TOTP helpers using pyotp + bcrypt for recovery codes. (2) routes/auth.py has new 2FA endpoints: /auth/2fa/status, /auth/2fa/setup, /auth/2fa/verify-setup, /auth/2fa/verify-login, /auth/2fa/disable, /auth/2fa/regenerate-recovery. (3) Login flow checks totp_enabled and returns challenge_token (5-min JWT) if 2FA is active. (4) dependencies.py user_response() strips all TOTP-related fields. (5) services/gdpr_export.py provides build_user_export() with richer structure. (6) /users/me/export returns legacy keys + _iter188 nested block. (7) admin/stats, search/global, health_metrics.py use read_db for SECONDARY_PREFERRED reads.
